explain: Archives of Docker volumes, made and kept on the machine itself. Only their names and sizes come here: the files never leave the machine. Schedule a backup from the Scheduled tasks tab.
notConfigured: This machine has no backup folder. Set ARMADOK_BACKUP_DIR on its worker (see the worker example) to turn backups on.
keep: Archives to keep for this volume
restoreWarn: The files of {{archive}} are written into the volume and replace files with the same names. The volume must not be used by any container.
typeName: Type the volume name to confirm
truncated: The folder holds more archives than can be listed: the oldest are not shown.
